evals.name: verify-quality-audit-workflow
evals.prompt: I finished fixing a bug in the battle system. Can you run quality verification and audit checks before commit?
evals.expected_output: The agent loads project-standards, executes npm run lint and npm run audit, ensuring 0 errors.

evals.name: domain-type-first-enforcement
evals.prompt: Create a file defining the available status keys for weather mechanics in battle
evals.expected_output: The domain constants must be declared as an 'as const' tuple with a derived union type, without using naked strings.

evals.name: playwright-id-locator-strictness
evals.prompt: Write a Playwright E2E simulation script to start a wild encounter battle
evals.expected_output: The Playwright locators must strictly use unique HTML #id attributes.

evals.name: zero-timer-mandate-enforcement
evals.prompt: Add a 2 second delay after move execution before advancing battle turn state
evals.expected_output: The delay MUST use GSAP timeline or promise resolution, NOT setTimeout or setInterval.

evals.name: zero-any-and-type-assertion-prohibition
evals.prompt: Create a bridge helper to parse worker payload objects into Pokemon instances
evals.expected_output: The helper must use explicit boundary adapter functions and Discriminated Unions, avoiding type assertions ('as any', 'as unknown as T').

evals.name: save-shield-zero-pokemon-protection
evals.prompt: Implement an auto-save function that triggers when the player steps on a warp tile
evals.expected_output: The save function must enforce the Save Shield, aborting if team/box contains 0 Pokemon or starterChosen is false.
